Name: PocketBin
Author: Shad9wGuy
Description:
[left][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51827/51827-1789102628-816627227.png[/img][/left]
PocketBin brings the farm shipping bin straight into your inventory menu so you can sell items easyly 
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51827/51827-1788777136-1479705327.gif[/img]
[left][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51827/51827-1789145316-805552222.png[/img][/left]
Access your shipping bin directly from your inventory,press the 'G' key to ship all produce at once and if You enable the Immediate Payment option in the GMCM you will get paid immediately whenever you ship Items

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51827/51827-1789145312-380796694.png[/img]
1.Download The latest version of SMAPI
2.Download PocketBin and extract the Zip into Mods folder

[left][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51827/51827-1789145312-2120334875.png[/img][/left]
Inspired by Platonymous's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3219]Ship from Inventory[/url] mod

Manifest.Name: PocketBin
Manifest.Description: PocketBin adds a little shipping bin directly into your inventory menu so you can ship products from anywhere
